reconstruction_equivalence_geometry.description: Formal scaffold for the geometry of reconstruction equivalence classes in the Mono-Process Framework.
core_principles: Indistinguishability under projection defines an equivalence relation on continuation histories.
Equivalence classes are sets of preimages that map to the same observable trace or projected state.
The dimension and volume of these classes represent the inherent reconstruction ambiguity.

equivalence_classes.name: same_observable_trace
equivalence_classes.basis: Distinct state histories map to identical metric traces.
equivalence_classes.geometry: Equivalence fiber in high-dimensional state space.

equivalence_classes.name: same_projected_state
equivalence_classes.basis: States outside the admissibility window map to the same null state.
equivalence_classes.geometry: Exterior complement set relative to the admissibility window.

equivalence_classes.name: same_transport_flux
equivalence_classes.basis: Aggregate transport over CSI domains collapses distinct path histories.

equivalence_classes.name: same_delta_branch_family
equivalence_classes.basis: Multiple symmetric branches satisfy the same selection minima.
equivalence_classes.geometry: Discrete set of admissible continuation preimages.

equivalence_classes.name: same_recursive_loss_basin
equivalence_classes.basis: Iterative loss accumulation leads to stable basins of indistinguishability.
equivalence_classes.geometry: Stable attractors in reconstruction ambiguity space.
